subject.title: feat(ios): Liquid Glass UI, Action Button & Dynamic Island

question: Should OpenClaw accept a native iOS Action Button/App Intent path into Talk Mode now, or fold that work into the broader Siri/AppIntent product issue?
rationale: The remaining unique value is a new platform shortcut and Live Activity behavior on top of current-main iOS UX work; automation can identify defects, but it cannot choose the product scope or whether this stale branch should be rescued.

options.title: Rebase and narrow to Talk Mode intent
options.body: Keep this PR open only if the contributor or a maintainer rebases it onto current RootTabs and limits it to the approved AppIntent/Talk Mode behavior plus required proof.

options.title: Fold into broader AppIntent issue
options.body: Treat the AppIntent direction as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/47584 and pause this branch until that product/security scope is settled.

options.title: Request a fresh PR
options.body: Close or pause this stale branch and ask for a new minimal PR that starts from current main and preserves the existing iOS architecture.

recommendation.title: Rebase and narrow to Talk Mode intent
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if the contributor or a maintainer rebases it onto current RootTabs and limits it to the approved AppIntent/Talk Mode behavior plus required proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main RootTabs and Liquid Glass iOS direction most directly overlaps the product and rebase choice.
